title: Counter loop states
statement: For a type $S$, define a counter-loop state to be one of: a body-running state carrying an element of $S$; a decrement-running state carrying a flag phase; a designated exit state reached after counter underflow; or a designated escape state reached when the body reaches its specified exit.
